title: Adaptation of foundation models in medical image analysis: mechanisms, evidence, and deployment considerations
title_zh: 医学影像分析中基础模型的适配：机制、证据与部署考量
abstract: Abstract Foundation models, pretrained on diverse data, objectives, or modalities for reuse across downstream tasks, are increasingly applied to medical image analysis. Their performance depends not only on pretraining but also on how they are adapted to specific tasks, data regimes, and deployment settings. Whereas previous reviews have considered adaptation within broader syntheses, this review focuses specifically on post-pretraining interventions applied to existing FMs. Using a structured narrative review with a systematic, auditable workflow, we identified 719 eligible reports representing 705 independent studies. Of these, 473 provided controlled comparative evidence: 322 formally published studies formed the primary synthesis and 151 preprint-only studies a sensitivity layer. Adaptation was organized into five non-mutually exclusive families: parameter-level, representation-level, objective-level, data-centric, and architectural/sequence-level adaptation, with model use and update regime analyzed separately. Controlled comparisons showed no consistent ranking among frozen, parameter-efficient, partial, or full updating, or across broader adaptation families; outcomes varied by task, data regime, comparator, and evaluation setting. Clinical-readiness evidence remained limited: 173/705 studies (24.5%) had confirmed independent external validation, 10 (1.4%) reported calibration or uncertainty evidence, and 97/322 formally published comparative studies (30.1%) included a qualifying externally validated arm. Overall, FM adaptation is a context-dependent design space rather than a hierarchy of preferred strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要：基础模型在多样化数据、目标或模态上进行预训练，以便在下游任务中重用，正日益应用于医学影像分析。其性能不仅取决于预训练，还取决于如何针对特定任务、数据环境和部署设置进行适配。此前的综述多关注更广泛的合成研究，而本综述专注于对现有基础模型进行的后预训练干预。采用结构化叙事综述与系统可审计工作流程，我们识别出719份符合条件的报告，代表705项独立研究。其中473项提供了受控比较证据：322项正式发表的研究构成主要合成，151项仅为预印本构成敏感性层。适配被划分为五个非互斥的类别：参数级、表示级、目标级、数据中心级以及架构/序列级适配，并分别分析模型使用与更新方案。受控比较显示，在冻结、参数高效、部分或完整更新，或更广泛的适配类别之间没有一致的排名；结果因任务、数据环境、对照组和评估设置而异。临床可用性证据仍有限：173/705项研究（24.5%）确认了独立外部验证，10项（1.4%）报告了校准或不确定性证据，97/322项正式发表的比较研究（30.1%）包含了具备外部验证的对照组。总体而言，基础模型适配是一个依赖上下文的设计空间，而非优先策略的层级。
